Market today:
The market mood is cautious, driven by rising inflation worries and higher Treasury yields. These factors typically put pressure on growth-oriented tech and chip names, which make up most of your portfolio.

Your holdings:

Watch:
Keep a close eye on Treasury yields and any further inflation data. Also, monitor the broader chip sector's reaction to outlooks like SK Hynix's.

Bottom line:
Focus on managing your high-risk, leveraged positions and respecting your stops in this yield-sensitive environment.
